summary: Bundle C (Responsibilities & Tasks engine) frontend E2E tested. Nearly all flows PASS: Work tab, create modal (one-time + recurring), item drawer, assignee accept/start/submit, approver request_changes+approve with 2-cycle history, self-task (member restricted modal), owner self-task on/off, My Work hub, regression tabs, mobile viewport. Found 1 real bug: Save on timezone button navigates page to /friends unexpectedly. Also a minor UX gap: cross-center My Work item click opens drawer correctly but URL is not updated with ?tab=work&item= deep link; progress percent label doesn't visually refresh immediately after moving the manual progress slider.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking rc-settings-timezone-save reproducibly navigates the whole page to /friends (both on valid tz like America/New_York and invalid like Mars/Base). Value does get persisted on valid input, but user is thrown out of Settings tab immediately. Button has no type attribute (defaults to submit) though no enclosing <form> was detected — root cause likely a stray global handler or router side-effect triggered by the button click / API response. Blocks any follow-up interaction with settings after save.

Setting rc-drawer-progress-slider to 50 updates the input value (slider thumb moves) but the '0%' label in rc-drawer-progress does not refresh in-session; probably no optimistic update and no reload of item after change event.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking rc-my-work-item-{id} correctly opens the item drawer, but the URL only becomes /responsibility-center/{cid} (query string ?tab=work&item={id} is missing). Per spec the deep link should be reflected in the URL so it can be shared/reloaded.

action_items: Fix timezone save navigation-away bug: give the button an explicit type="button" and investigate why saveTimezone triggers navigation to /friends (checked apiClient interceptors — no explicit /friends redirect found; also happens on the invalid tz path which does NOT call reload()/navigate). Repro: open /responsibility-center/{id}?tab=settings, type any value into rc-settings-timezone-input, click rc-settings-timezone-save -> page immediately navigates to /friends.
Update RcMyWork deep-link navigation to push ?tab=work&item={id} to URL so the link is copy-shareable.
Update progress percentage label reactively when rc-drawer-progress-slider is moved (either optimistic set or refetch item on input change).
critical_code_review_comments: ResponsibilityCenterDashboard.jsx SettingsTab: rc-settings-timezone-save <button> lacks type="button". Even though no <form> was detected around it, this is best practice and rules out submit-triggered navigation in embedded contexts.

RcItemDrawer: onChange of the range slider likely fires a network PATCH but the local `item.progress_percent` state used to render the label is only updated after refetch — consider optimistic UI to feel responsive.

RcMyWork navigation should use `navigate(`/responsibility-center/${cid}?tab=work&item=${id}`)` (query params) so page reload/refresh preserves drawer state and the deep-link works from external shares.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bundle C flows are largely green. Main fix required: rc-settings-timezone-save button causes navigation to /friends. Repro deterministic — happens on both valid and invalid timezone values. Please retest after fix. Also verify My Work deep-link URL now contains ?tab=work&item= and progress percent updates in real time. Recurring series and approval cycles work perfectly (2-cycle history verified).
rca of the issue: Timezone save -> unexpected navigation to /friends. RCA hypothesis: button has no type attribute (implicit submit) AND some upstream React Router state or the PATCH response side-effect triggers a full navigation to /friends. Since the invalid-tz path (which never calls reload() or navigate()) ALSO navigates, the trigger is not in saveTimezone itself. Likely candidates: (a) a global keyboard/click handler in TopStarBar or Layout tied to focus loss, (b) a service-worker style route interception, (c) an axios response interceptor that maps a specific error/status to a redirect. Recommend logging navigation source with useNavigate wrapper to identify the caller.
